## Learning objectives

<!-- TODO: confirm with the workshop plan. -->

By the end of this part, you will be able to:

 - Define a molecular phenotype from spatial transcriptomics data.
 - Apply several feature selection approaches and explain how they differ.
 - Assess whether the selected features are clinically relevant, and whether the selection is stable.
 - Choose an approach that suits a given question and dataset.
